name: UGC video
description: A person talking to the camera about your product: the script, a voice for it (or your own recording), a still of them with the product, then the talking clip.

slots.label: Script
slots.placeholder: Okay, I have to show you this. I've been using it every morning for two weeks and…

slots.label: Where they are
slots.placeholder: In a bright kitchen, morning light, phone held at arm's length

params.prompt: A natural, candid smartphone selfie-style photo for a UGC ad: the person from the first image holding the product from the second image towards the camera, product label clearly visible and unchanged, the person looking into the lens. {{slots.setting}}
The person talks to the camera naturally, holding the product. {{slots.script}}
